v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

source.scope: Psalmi & antiphonæ ex Psalterio secundum diem

text.en: Blessed are all * they that fear the Lord. ‡
Let them all be confounded * who hate Sion.

text.la: De profúndis * clamávi ad te, Dómine. ‡
text.en: Out of the depths * I have cried to thee, O Lord. ‡

text.la: Dómine, * non est exaltátum cor meum. ‡
text.en: O Lord * my heart is not exalted. ‡

text.la: Elégit Dóminus * Sion in habitatiónem sibi.
text.en: The Lord hath chosen * Sion for his dwelling.

text.la: Ecce sacérdos magnus, qui in diébus suis plácuit Deo, et invéntus est iustus: et in témpore iracúndiæ factus est reconciliátio.
text.en: Behold an high priest, who in his days pleased God, and was found righteous, and in the time of wrath he was made a propitiation.

v.la: Iustum dedúxit Dóminus per vias rectas.
v.en: The Lord guided the just in right paths.

r.en: And showed him the kingdom of God.

text.la: O Doctor óptime, * Ecclésiæ sanctæ lumen, beáte Petre, divínæ legis amátor, deprecáre pro nobis Fílium Dei.
text.en: O right excellent Teacher * Light of the Holy Church, Peter, blessed lover of the Divine Law, pray for us to the Son of God.

text.la: Concéde nos, quǽsumus, omnípotens Deus: beáti Petri Confessóris tui atque Pontíficis mónita et exémpla sectári; ut per terréstrium rerum contémptum ætérna gáudia consequámur.
text.en: Grant, we beseech Thee, Almighty God, so to profit by the teaching and example of thy blessed Confessor and Bishop Peter, that, like him, we may lightly esteem the things which are seen and temporal, and finally attain unto those good things which are unseen and eternal.

office.title: S. Petri Damiani Episcopi Confessoris et Ecclesiæ Doctoris
